## Selected original source projects

- [NY Municipal Decision-Maker Monitor](https://github.com/zimkk/erdman-ny-county): Python, FastAPI, and Next.js system that monitors public contacts across 60 New York county sites, detects changes, stores history, and emits webhook notifications
- [WonderKit](https://github.com/zimkk/wonderkit): Agent-native TypeScript SaaS foundation with multi-tenant auth, provider-swappable LLMs, durable agent runs, pgvector memory, evaluation, billing, and deployment paths
- [Google Maps Lead Scraper](https://github.com/zimkk/Lead-Scraper-Google-Maps): Async, resumable Playwright system for geographic business discovery, qualification, deduplication, and CSV or Excel export
- [Mynecraft](https://github.com/zimkk/mynecraft): Browser voxel engine written in TypeScript with Three.js, procedural terrain, worker-streamed chunks, custom lighting, physics, mob AI, multiple dimensions, and versioned saves
- [Legal Document Summarizer](https://github.com/zimkk/legal-Document-Summerizer): Local legal-document pipeline for Llama 3 fine-tuning, PDF and DOCX processing, structured summarization, and Gemma-based verification
- [n8nHub](https://github.com/zimkk/n8nhub): Searchable Next.js automation knowledge platform organizing more than 2,000 n8n workflows
